campaigns.name: One Source of Truth
campaigns.objective: awareness — educate TypeScript developers about schema duplication pain and how SchemaGuard solves it
campaigns.big_idea: Position SchemaGuard as the inevitable evolution beyond Zod and Yup by eliminating redundant schema definitions. Highlight that your types are your schema — no more drift, no more duplication. Use benchmark data to show superior performance.
campaigns.hook: Your TypeScript types are already perfect. Why write them twice?

sample_copy.headline: One source of truth: the types you already wrote.
sample_copy.body: Stop maintaining Zod schemas that drift from your TypeScript interfaces. SchemaGuard generates runtime validators directly from your types — no duplication, no drift, 5.5x faster than Zod.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand's technical, matter-of-fact tone and builds directly on the key message 'One source of truth: the types you already wrote.'

campaigns.name: TypeScript, Trusted
campaigns.objective: signups — drive developers to install SchemaGuard for API validation
campaigns.big_idea: Focus on production reliability: show how SchemaGuard prevents runtime errors caused by API contract drift. Frame it as essential for teams that depend on accurate type validation at runtime.
campaigns.hook: A production incident revealed your API response didn’t match your types. SchemaGuard prevents that.

sample_copy.headline: Trust your types in production.
sample_copy.body: APIs change. Your frontend types shouldn’t lie. SchemaGuard compiles your TypeScript types into runtime validators so you catch mismatches early — not in production.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Reflects the benchmark-driven, technical tone and addresses the ICP's buying trigger: a production incident due to type/schema drift.

campaigns.name: The 2.1 kB Challenge
campaigns.objective: awareness — highlight SchemaGuard’s minimal runtime footprint
campaigns.big_idea: Challenge developers to consider how much they’re shipping: compare SchemaGuard’s 2.1 kB gzipped core to Zod’s larger bundle size. Turn bundle efficiency into a competitive advantage.
campaigns.hook: Your validation library shouldn’t weigh down your bundle. Ours is 2.1 kB gzipped.

sample_copy.headline: Runtime validation under 2.1 kB.
sample_copy.body: Most validation libraries add bulk. SchemaGuard’s core is 2.1 kB gzipped — smaller, faster, and compiled from your types. See the benchmark.

campaigns.success_metric: social shares of bundle size claim
campaigns.why_on_brand: Leverages the brand’s fact-based, performance-oriented voice and emphasizes a proven differentiator: minimal bundle size.

campaigns.name: No More Drift
campaigns.objective: community — engage developers frustrated with schema maintenance
campaigns.big_idea: Start a conversation around schema drift — a silent killer in TypeScript apps. Invite developers to share their stories and discover SchemaGuard as the solution.
campaigns.hook: When was the last time your Zod schema got out of sync with your API?

sample_copy.headline: Schema drift is costing you time.
sample_copy.body: You update a type, forget the Zod schema, and ship a bug. SchemaGuard eliminates this — your types are the source. No sync needed.

campaigns.success_metric: number of community comments and replies
campaigns.why_on_brand: Speaks directly to the ICP’s pain point using the brand’s clear, technical tone and avoids marketing fluff.

confidence.notes: Campaigns are grounded in APP_PROFILE proof points and BRAND_DNA voice. No invented metrics or testimonials used.
